grammar.topic: Reported speech: statements (said that / told me that)
explainTr: Birinin sözünü başkasına aktarırken fiil genellikle bir adım geçmişe kayar: 'I am tired' → She said that she was tired. Present Simple → Past Simple, will → would, can → could, Present Perfect → Past Perfect.
'Say' ve 'tell' farklıdır: 'tell' yanında kişi alır (She told me that...), 'say' almaz (She said that...). 'That' günlük konuşmada düşebilir.
Zaman ve zamir de değişir: I → she/he, my → her/his, tomorrow → the next day, today → that day, now → then.
grammar.compareTr: Türkçede 'Yarın arayacağım dedi' deriz; fiil zamanı kaymaz. İngilizcede 'She said that she would call the next day' demen gerekir: will → would, tomorrow → the next day.
table: "I am busy." → He said he was busy.
"I can help." → He said he could help.
"I have finished." → She said she had finished.
"I'll come tomorrow." → She said she'd come the next day.

reading.title: A message from the principal
reading.text:
On Monday morning, Hafsa arrived early at Lincoln Elementary School. She was substituting for Mr. Walker's fourth-grade class, and she felt a little nervous. At the front office, Mr. Brown handed her a blue folder.

"The principal left a message for you," he said. "She said that she would be at a district meeting all morning. She told me that you could call her cell phone if there was an emergency. She also said that the students had a spelling test that day."

Hafsa wrote everything down. Then Mr. Brown added, "Oh, and Ms. Davis said that the assembly was moving to 1:30 because the gym was being cleaned. She told me to remind every sub about it."

"Thank you," Hafsa said. "I will tell the students."

At lunch, Ms. Park, the teacher next door, asked how the morning was going. "Fine," Hafsa answered. "The principal said that the test would be easy, and she was right. The students finished in twenty minutes."

Ms. Park smiled. "Ms. Davis always says that the first day is the hardest one."

Hafsa laughed. She felt much better now. She told Mr. Brown that she wanted to come back the next week, and he said that he would put her name on the list.

options: She did not like the school.
She wanted to come back the next week.
questions.whyTr: Metin: 'She told Mr. Brown that she wanted to come back the next week'.

questions.q: What does Ms. Davis always say?
options: The first day is the hardest.
questions.whyTr: Metin: 'the first day is the hardest one'.

writing.promptTr: Bir arkadaşına kısa bir e-posta yaz. Müdürün veya Mr. Brown'ın bugün söylediklerini dolaylı anlatımla aktar (said that / told me that).
writing.promptEn: Write a short email to a friend. Report what the principal or Mr. Brown said today.
writing.model: Hi Linda, I had a busy day at school today. The principal said that the students were going on a field trip on Friday. She told me that every student needed a permission form. Mr. Brown said that the forms were due on Wednesday. He also told me that the assembly would start at 1:30. I wrote everything down, so I will not forget. I think the children will love the trip, and I am a little excited too. Talk to you soon, Hafsa
checklistTr: Said that / told me that kullandın mı?
Fiilleri bir adım geçmişe kaydırdın mı (is → was, will → would)?
Cümleler büyük harfle başlıyor ve noktayla bitiyor mu?
